content: नागरक, नागरिक {%a.%} [नगरे भवः वुञ्] .²1 Town-bred, town-born. .²2 Polite, courteous, courtly; नागरिकवृत्त्या संज्ञापयैनाम् <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; साधु आर्य नागरिकोऽसि <ls>V. 2</ls>. .²3 Clever, shrewd, cunning (विदग्ध). .{@-कः@} .²1 A citizen. .²2 A polite or courteous man, a gallant, one who shows exaggerated attention to his first mistress while he is courting some one else. .²3 One who has contracted the vices of a town. .²4 A thief. .²5 An artist. .²6 The chief of the police; <ls>V. 5</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. .²7 A city-superintendent; <ab>cf.</ab> नागरिकप्रणिधिः <ls>Kau. A.</ls> .²8 A kind of coitus; ऊरुमूलोपरि स्थित्वा योषिदूरुद्वयं रमेत् . ग्रीवां धृत्वा कराभ्यां च बन्धो नागरको मतः .. <ls>Ratimañjarī.</ls> .²9 (<ab>pl.</ab>) planets opposite to each other. .{@-कम्@} .²1 Dry ginger. .({@-रिकम्@}) The toll levied from a town.
